aiAnalysis.summary: The rep failed to engage with the lead's parking objection and immediately accepted the rejection without attempting discovery, reframing value, or exploring alternatives. The call lasted under a minute with no effort to understand the lead's fitness goals, discuss the founding membership benefits, or schedule a future conversation.

keyMoments.description: Rep greeted Carolina professionally but did not reintroduce themselves or confirm the purpose of the call.
Lead immediately stated parking is a dealbreaker and the location won't work for weekend visits.
Rep accepted the objection without probing further, offering solutions (valet, alternative times, carpooling), or pivoting to membership value.
No attempt to save the deal, book a future call, gather contact info for other locations, or create urgency around founding membership.

aiAnalysis.coachingTip: Never accept the first objection—dig deeper with questions like 'What if we could solve the parking issue?' or 'Have you considered off-peak hours when parking is easier?' Always pivot to value: 'I understand parking is a concern, but our founding members lock in lifetime rates and exclusive perks that won't be available later. Can we explore if there's a way to make this work?'
